Our client, located in the Beveren region, is looking for a Supervisor Piping & Mechanical with strong technical expertise and people leadership skills.
 
 

• You’ll lead, coordinate and supervise daily piping and mechanical maintenance activities with a strong focus on HSE, quality, cost control and operational continuity 

• You’ll plan, prioritize and allocate maintenance work to ensure efficient execution of both preventive and corrective maintenance activities 

• You’ll organize daily toolbox meetings, communicate priorities and ensure compliance with all safety procedures and permit-to-work requirements 

• You’ll actively supervise field activities and provide technical support to technicians and contractors during the execution of maintenance work 

• You’ll coordinate closely with Operations, Engineering, Reliability and Inspection departments to align maintenance priorities and ensure efficient plant availability 

• You’ll ensure the safe and efficient execution of maintenance activities on piping systems, pressure vessels, heat exchangers, storage tanks and other static equipment 

• You’ll safeguard the mechanical integrity of plant assets by ensuring that maintenance and repair activities are executed according to engineering standards, site procedures and applicable regulations 

• You’ll support inspection programs and follow up on findings, integrity assessments, statutory inspections and corrective actions 

• You’ll coordinate and manage external contractors, ensuring compliance with safety, quality, planning and budget requirements 

• You’ll monitor work quality and verify that repairs, modifications and installations are completed according to specifications and industry standards 

• You’ll support the preparation, execution and evaluation of shutdowns, turnarounds and maintenance projects 

• You’ll drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on reliability, safety, efficiency and maintenance performance 

• You’ll ensure accurate maintenance administration and reporting in SAP, including work order completion, time registration and maintenance history 
 

• You have a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a comparable technical qualification, or equivalent by experience 

• You have at least 5 years of relevant maintenance experience within the petrochemical, chemical, oil & gas or related process industry 

• You’re experienced in a supervisory, team leader or coordination role within an industrial environment 

• You have solid knowledge of piping systems, pressure equipment, heat exchangers, storage tanks and other static equipment 

• You have a good understanding of mechanical integrity principles, inspection methodologies and reliability-driven maintenance practices 

• You have a strong knowledge of HSE requirements, permit-to-work systems, contractor management and process safety 

• You’re experienced with SAP or another CMMS system and good proficiency in Microsoft Office applications 

• You own strong planning, organizational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to effectively manage changing priorities 

• You have excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, enabling effective collaboration across multiple disciplines 

• You are fluent in Dutch and have a good command of English 

• You have a hands-on leadership style with the ability to motivate, coach and develop people

Our client is a leading international retail organization operating across multiple countries. This company is investing heavily in the modernization and optimization of its technology landscape, with SAP playing a central role in supporting business operations and future growth.

As part of its ongoing digital transformation journey, the organization is strengthening its SAP Retail team to enhance business processes, improve operational efficiency, and support strategic initiatives across procurement, supply chain, inventory management, pricing, and store operations.

As IT SAP Retail Consultant, you will join a team of experienced professionals working closely with stakeholders across business and IT functions to deliver impactful solutions that support the organization's long-term ambitions.

As Senior SAP Retail Business Consultant, you will be responsible for supporting, optimizing, and evolving SAP Retail solutions across the end-to-end retail value chain.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Supporting and enhancing SAP Retail business processes across procurement, inventory management, assortment management, pricing, replenishment, logistics, and store operations.
• Gathering business requirements and translating them into functional specifications and effective SAP solutions.
• Configuring SAP Retail functionalities and ensuring alignment with SAP best practices.
• Driving process standardization and continuous improvement initiatives across business units and countries.
• Providing 2nd and 3rd line functional support, investigating incidents, identifying root causes, and coordinating issue resolution.
• Contributing to SAP transformation and S/4HANA-related projects by participating in workshops, solution design activities, testing, and deployment initiatives.
• Collaborating with business users, project teams, implementation partners, and external service providers.
• Supporting system integrations with eCommerce platforms, warehouse management solutions, financial applications, POS systems, EDI interfaces, and other third-party solutions.
• Assisting data migration activities and promoting data quality and governance best practices.
• Acting as a trusted advisor for business stakeholders while mentoring junior team members and facilitating knowledge transfer.
• Ensuring the stability, performance, and long-term sustainability of SAP Retail solutions

To succeed in this role, you will combine strong SAP Retail expertise with excellent stakeholder management and problem-solving capabilities.

You ideally bring:

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Supply Chain, or a related field.
• At least 8 years of SAP experience, including a minimum of 5 years focused on SAP Retail.
• Proven experience working within large-scale retail organizations and complex international environments.
• Strong expertise in:
• SAP Retail
• SAP MM
• SAP SD
• Assortment Management
• Article Master Data
• Purchasing Processes
• Inventory Management
• Invoice Verification
• Retail Pricing
• Exposure to SAP S/4HANA Retail, SAP CAR, SAP Datasphere, SAP BTP, or SAP Integration Suite would be considered a strong advantage.
• Solid understanding of retail and supply chain business processes.
• Experience in solution design, requirements gathering, testing, and change management.
• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
• Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities.
• The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
• Fluency in English and either French or Dutch.

Are you a dedicated CE truck driver with a passion for the construction industry? As a concrete mixer driver, you’ll deliver fresh concrete daily to various sites in the Antwerp and Brussels areas. You’ll operate a modern fleet and receive clear routes and delivery plans from central dispatch. Your main job is to safely load concrete at our production sites and deliver it on time to different construction locations. You’ll be the face of the company, ensuring proper handover of documents, communicating effectively with customers, and following specific guidelines for each delivery.

On a typical workday, you’ll start at one of our state-of-the-art production sites in Sint-Katelijne-Waver or Hemiksem. After loading your mixer, you’ll follow your designated route to the client, where you’ll deliver the concrete. Your day will include several trips within urban areas, sometimes with restricted access. In these cases, you’ll get extra instructions and support from dispatch. In between, you’ll make sure all transport documents are completed accurately and thoroughly. You work independently but can always rely on an experienced team for support.

Do you see yourself working in a well-organized company with a strong focus on quality and safety? Do you want to be part of a growing family business and enjoy competitive pay, extra benefits, and the possibility of a permanent contract? Apply today and become the driving force behind our concrete mixers!

• You have a valid CE driver’s license and a valid driver card

• You have experience as a CE driver, preferably with completing transport documents

• You speak and understand communicative English

• You are physically fit and motivated to work hands-on

• You are resilient and can confidently navigate complex routes, including urban settings

• You work accurately and appreciate clear agreements

• You’re willing to work a flexible schedule (including overtime possible)

Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology enterprise bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this initiative, the company makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases. They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are seeking motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

Start your career in Pharma in a Lab Support role!

Are you ready to make a real impact in the world of biotechnology? 

Are you detail-oriented and comfortable working in a rapid changing, clean environment with very strict procedures? Do you want to contribute to the production of innovative, life-saving cell therapies? Then this could be the opportunity for you.

After extensive training in aseptic working and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), you’ll join our Operations Team and support the production of the Carvykti treatment in a highly controlled cleanroom environment.

What You’ll Do
	
• Support the daily aseptic and manual production process, following strict procedures and quality standards.	
• Prepare workstations, equipment, tools and materials for production.	
• Clean and disinfect materials and equipment to maintain a sterile environment.	
• Inspect equipment and ensure the correct transfer of materials between production zones.	
• Work closely with operators and team leads to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality therapies to patients.
Good to Know
You’ll work in a sterile environment wearing protective clothing. This role follows a shift schedule including weekends, but no night shifts. Full training is provided.

We are looking for you if:
	
• You live near Gent/Zwijnaarde or have reliable transportation such as bike or Car.	
• Fluent in English, you thrive in teamwork and are eager to learn new skills.	
• You are accountable and motivated to make a difference in patient's lives. 	
• Your attention to detail is unmatched.	
• Bonus points for familiarity with GMP standards, aseptic techniques, sterilization methods, and MS Office.

• Minimum 8 years of proven experience in a technical office environment
• Native Dutch speaker with good command of English and French
• Strong analytical mindset with a pragmatic, solution-oriented approach
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills
• Initial experience in team management or coaching is required

Lead Solution Architect - Technical Lead

Location: Brussels
Work model: 2 days/week onsite
Contract: Long-term freelance assignment
Language: French + English OR Dutch + English

 

I'm currently looking for a Lead Solution Architect to join the architecture team of a large organisation in the public sector.

This is not a standard Solution Architect position.

You will become the technical reference for a team of 8-9 experienced Solution Architects, taking the lead on architectural decisions while remaining close enough to the technology and development teams to challenge technical choices, review solutions and provide hands-on architectural guidance.

The organisation is looking for someone who can combine deep technical expertise with strong leadership and communication skills - someone who can challenge experienced architects and developers, but also confidently defend architectural decisions at Board and business level.

Your role

As Lead Solution Architect, you will:

• Act as the technical reference point for the architecture team.
• Take the lead on complex architectural decisions and defend them towards the Architecture Board and business stakeholders.
• Define, evolve and enforce architectural principles, standards and best practices.
• Challenge architectural choices made across multiple projects and Scrum teams.
• Support Solution Architects in solving complex technical and architectural problems.
• Participate in architecture reviews and contribute to the organisation's technology roadmap.
• Work closely with development teams and remain technically credible with senior developers and technical leads.
• Review technical designs and, where relevant, participate in code reviews.
• Guide teams through technology choices, integration patterns, security considerations and architectural trade-offs.
• Provide architectural leadership across a combination of legacy modernisation and new technology initiatives.
• Act as a natural leader within the architecture community, without direct people-management responsibility.
 

Your background

We're looking for a very senior Solution Architect with a strong technical foundation and the maturity to operate at both technical and strategic level.

You ideally bring:

• Significant experience in Solution Architecture / Software Architecture.
• A strong technical background in Java, ideally within large and complex environments.
• Good understanding of Angular / modern application architectures.
• Strong knowledge of application integration and security.
• Experience working with both legacy environments and modern architectures.
• Experience in large-scale, multi-project organisations.
• The ability to challenge technical decisions and communicate complex subjects clearly.
• Experience interacting with senior management, architecture boards or business stakeholders.
• The credibility to work directly with experienced developers, technical leads and other architects.
• Strong leadership and influencing skills, without necessarily having formal management responsibility.
• Excellent English communication skills. French or Dutch is a plus.
The person

The ideal candidate is someone who is already considered a technical reference by the people around them.

You don't necessarily need to be the person with the biggest title in the room. You need to be the person others turn to when an architectural problem becomes difficult.

You are comfortable moving between:

Developer → Architect → Architecture Board → Business

without losing credibility at any level.

This is a long-term freelance opportunity for an architect looking to take on a high-impact technical leadership role within a complex organisation.

Since 1854, Katoen Natie has grown from a Belgian family business into a global logistics powerhouse with operations spanning five continents. Based in the strategic Gent Port, we specialize in warehousing, transport, cargo handling, and supply chain solutions for international clients. Our success stems from combining 170  years of expertise with innovative technology and a personal, SME approach to business.
Join our dynamic team where tradition meets innovation, and every day brings new challenges in the exciting world of international logistics.

We're seeking an experienced Warehouse Team Leader to join our operations team at our state-of-the-art facility in Gent Zeehaven. Team Leadership: Coach and motivate warehouse staff to consistently achieve operational KPIs and quality standards
Operational Planning: Create efficient work schedules, allocate resources, and optimize workflow processes
Hands-On Management: Lead by example - work directly with your team using forklifts and warehouse equipment when needed

Safety & Compliance: Ensure all safety protocols and quality standards are maintained at all times
Reporting: Provide regular updates to warehouse supervisors and operational management
Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to enhance efficiency and reduce operational costs

3  years of team leadership experience in warehouse, logistics, or distribution environments
Forklift certification (or commitment to obtain certification within 30 days)
Strong communication skills in Dutch and English (French is a plus)
Proven track record of meeting KPIs and managing operational deadlines
Physical stamina for hands-on warehouse work and extended periods on your feet
Flexible schedule - ability to work various shifts including occasional weekends
Problem-solving mindset with ability to make decisions under pressure

Preferred Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or related field or equal through experience
Experience with WMS (Warehouse Management Systems)
Knowledge of customs procedures and international shipping
Lean/Six Sigma certification or continuous improvement experience
Multilingual capabilities for our international client base

  • You have good technical insight and can work confidently with modern machinery.
  • You are flexible and have no problem working in different weather conditions.
  • You speak fluent Dutch or English.
  • You are able to get to our depot in Oostende independently every day.

Supported by private equity investors, the organisation is evolving from a traditional setup towards a more modern, performance-driven operating model. The company is located in the North of the province of West Flanders.

The Customer Service & Customs Coordinator will:

• Become a key member of a team of five customer service professionals, managing the complete order-to-cash process for an international B2B customer portfolio.
• Oversee and manage customs documentation and trade compliance activities for international import and export transactions.
• Act as the primary point of contact for customers, building strong relationships and ensuring an excellent service experience from order placement through delivery and invoicing.
• Proactively manage customer enquiries, orders, delivery follow-up, and issue resolution, ensuring customer satisfaction and operational excellence.
• Coordinate closely with planning, logistics, production, and sales teams to ensure seamless execution of customer commitments.
• Collaborate with freight forwarders and customs brokers to facilitate smooth and compliant cross-border shipments.
• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and digital transformation projects, helping modernise processes and enhance customer service efficiency.

• Strong organisational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

Our client is a major player in the logistics sector. They handle road transport, air freight, and sea freight.

The Antwerp branch is responsible for everything related to ocean freight. Around 100 employees work there and give their best every day to provide the highest possible level of service. They are seated in groups of four colleagues at work islands, spread over two floors. The atmosphere on the work floor is calm—sometimes hectic—but very pleasant. There is strong teamwork, and there is certainly room for regular laughter as well.

Every two weeks, a fruit basket is delivered to the departments. In addition, you can work with flexible hours, there are various opportunities for personal development, and subscriptions for the toll tunnel and the water bus are fully reimbursed.

In short: a very attractive employer!
